project.objective: Create a local CLI that manages AI-agent implementation workflow state.
targetUsers: Human project owner using Claude Code

constraints: Local files are the source of truth
No markdown files are created by default
nonGoals: No autonomous code execution in MVP
businessRules: Human-readable exports are generated only on request
architectureNotes: state.json stores workflow position and work graph

requirements.title: Capture project context
requirements.description: The update command stores durable project context in project.json.
acceptanceCriteria: aiqt update --json returns a deterministic CommandResult

decisions.decision: Use aiqt update as the single context mutation command.
decisions.reason: Avoids a large command surface with add-requirement/add-decision commands.
decisions.impact: Granular actions are handled internally by the update service.

assumptions.statement: The implementation agent runs outside AIQT for MVP.

risks.title: Overbuilding the planning engine too early
risks.description: M2 could accidentally drift into plan generation.
risks.mitigation: Keep workGraph empty and defer aiqt plan.

openQuestions.question: Which planning heuristic should M3 use first?
